initial_findings.issue: The README did not distinguish the repair-agent fixture boundary from the post-repair verifier's permitted reference implementation access.
The hidden-check, fixture-integrity, and unchanged-test claims lacked committed hashes, diffs, input definitions, and a verifier report.
New JSON and CLI boundaries produced basedpyright warnings.

remediation: Separated repair_agent_boundary from verifier_boundary in the manifest and README.
Added the differential verifier, verifier report, source/test/config/candidate/reference hashes, candidate diffs, and committed-artifact hash checks.
Replaced dynamic Any propagation with explicit JSON and command-line parsing.

verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v -> 56 passed
python3 -m json.tool on manifest, evaluation, and verifier report -> passed
SHA-256 values for the hidden verifier, diffs, and transcripts match their recorded references.
re_review.residual_risk: The reviewer did not independently retrieve the upstream QuixBugs reference source, so the external-source and reference hashes are internally recorded evidence rather than independently re-derived upstream proof.

final_recheck.scope: The machine-evidence validation was moved into the new type-clean external benchmark test file, and the evidence count was updated from 7 to 8.
